title: Add a uniqueness rule
summary: A uniqueness constraint prevents two nodes with a label from sharing the same chosen property value.
introduction: A uniqueness constraint prevents two nodes with a label from sharing the same chosen property value. Your task: Explain why a stable unique book id is useful.
learningObjectives: Explain why a stable unique book id is useful.

blocks.text: A uniqueness constraint prevents two nodes with a label from sharing the same chosen property value.
Use Neo4j 5+ locally with Neo4j Browser or another Cypher editor. These queries use fictional cma-prefixed ids. Cypher is not SQL and does not run in this site's SQL playground.

blocks.code: CREATE CONSTRAINT cma_book_id IF NOT EXISTS FOR (b:Book) REQUIRE b.id IS UNIQUE;

items: This graph constraint requires the chosen property to be unique for nodes with the stated label.

blocks.text: Neo4j creates the constraint if the existing Book ids satisfy it.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Existing duplicate ids can make this fail. Inspect practice data and create the constraint before repeated inserts when possible.
